A 206-year-old barn on 22 acres facing Pleasant Mountain

Weddings, showers, reunions and retreats in Bridgton, Maine. Now booking 2027.

Schedule a tour

The barn is ready for its first new stories

Our family has owned this farm for four generations. In 2020 we started turning the house, the barn and the ell into a place for events. We lowered the barn floor, poured cement, and lined the inside with its own original boards. The 200-year-old windows from the house now light the barn.

The barn holds 135 guests. The ell has rooms for the bride and groom and their parties to get ready. Outside there is a patio, a ceremony field facing Pleasant Mountain, and 22 acres of woods and lawn.

  • Weddings

    Sunday weddings for up to 135, with the ceremony in the field and the reception in the barn. Alcohol-free, family friendly.

    See weddings

  • The Barn

    The barn, the loft, the bridal and groom rooms, a prep kitchen for your caterer, the patio and the grounds.

    See the barn

  • Events and gatherings

    Showers, reunions, retreats, teas, small concerts, workshops and classes. Any kind of an event.

    See events and gatherings

October is something special here

The field looks straight at Pleasant Mountain. In the fall the color comes right up to the barn. We are open all of October for events and tours.

Evenings on the ridge

Imagine your guests enjoying the food, the music and the sunset. The patio has string lights, and the stone seating circle in the field was built from rocks that spent 200 years under the barn.

Four generations on Hio Ridge Road

Susan’s great-grandparents, Rosa and Howard Burnham, bought this farm in 1941. Her grandmother and her father each spent their retirement here. Now it is Susan and Richard’s turn.
